newsitem.title: USA: Amylin files for 1.5 million shares.
newsitem.headline: Amylin files for 1.5 million shares.

text.p: Amylin Pharmaceuticals Inc said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to issue up 1.5 million common shares.

In addition to the company offer, Johnson and Johnson Development Corp, one of the company's collaborative partners and an existing stockholder, has committed to purchase an aggregate $15 million worth of common shares estimated to be 1,153,846 shares in a private placement, the filing said.

The underwriters will be offered an over-allotment option of up to 225,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through UBS Securities, Hambrecht & Quist and Vector Securities International Inc.
The net proceeds will be used to fund phase III development of pramlintide, research and development and other general corporate purposes.
The San Diego, Calif-based company is focused on developing novel therapeutics for treating people with diabetes and other metabolic disorders.
